test -f "$PROF_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
mv app/build/outputs/apk/free/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
